property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) must NOT succeed when newOwner == address(0) (reference always reverts / does not set owner to zero), while the mutant allows the call to succeed and results in owner == address(0) for some input.
change_summary: Require newOwner can be zero address removed, allowing transferOwnership to set owner to zero even when passed zero (original required non-zero); this changes resulting owner after call when newOwner == address(0).
